title: Messaging — Mux Update — payload
description: Narrow a stored grant — a smaller scope or an earlier expiry — without a new member signature. Anything that widens is refused. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

scope.description: The new effective scope. MUST be a subset of the grant's current effective scope.

expiresAt.description: The new effective expiry. MUST be in the future and no later than the grant's current effective expiry.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Update — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/update request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/update/0.1#response.

grant.description: The grant as it now stands.

changed.description: False when the request named the values already in force.
